lines.zh: 我的背鳍在水面拉出一道线
lines.en: My dorsal fin draws a line across the surface.
One tail beat carries me forward.
River sand rolls under my belly.
I patrol the shallows of the warm sea.

lines.zh: 我在浑水里也能听出方向。
lines.en: In murky water I still can tell direction.
I pass beneath a sunken log.

lines.zh: 我的鳃一开一合，慢慢来。
lines.en: My gills open and close, slow and steady.
I swing wide of a coral patch.

lines.zh: 水草缠上我的尾，我甩开。
lines.en: Weeds catch my tail; one flick and they're gone.

lines.zh: 我游到河口，咸淡交界处。
lines.en: I swim to the estuary where salt meets fresh.
I follow the shadow line of the bank.

lines.zh: 水里的味道变了，我转头。
lines.en: The taste of the water shifted; I turn.
I sink down, then rise again.

lines.zh: 我顺着暖流走快了一点。
lines.en: Riding the warm current, I speed up.

lines.zh: 我在这片水里绕了很多圈。
lines.en: I've circled this water many times.

lines.zh: 我的鼻尖擦过水底的石头。
lines.en: My snout grazes a stone on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我翻身，把肚子露给阳光。
lines.en: I roll and show my belly to the sun.

lines.zh: 水流一急，我就摆尾稳住。
lines.en: When the current picks up, my tail holds me steady.

lines.zh: 我停在水层里，尾巴懒懒摆
lines.en: I hold in the water, tail swinging lazily.
I open my mouth and let water pass my gills.
I listen underwater to the sound of boats.

lines.zh: 这顿还没着落，我先悬着。
lines.en: No meal yet, so I just hang here.

lines.zh: 水面的光在我背上碎成片。
lines.en: Light on the surface breaks into pieces on my back.

lines.zh: 我兜着圈打量这块礁石
lines.en: I circle this rock, sizing it up.
My stomach is reminding me.
I settle in the warm layer of water.
I turn on my side and watch the bank.

lines.zh: 一串气泡从我鳃边升上去
lines.en: A run of bubbles climbs from my gills.

lines.zh: 底下的泥里有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves in the mud below.
I have no legs, so all I can do is swim.
I break the surface with my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我一次也没有停过呼吸。
lines.en: I never once stopped breathing.
You're standing in the water; your legs give you away.

lines.zh: 我闻到你膝盖上的血味
lines.en: I smell the blood on your knee.

lines.zh: 水到你的膝盖，到我刚好。
lines.en: The water's at your knees and just right for me.
If you stay still, I'll come closer.
Your shadow wavers on the surface.
It's meat I'm after.
The fishy smell on your hands is strong.
We share this same water.
Don't slap the water with that stick.
I circle you slowly.
My hide is thick, and it still hurts.
One hard tail beat takes me clear.

lines.zh: 水里的血有一半是我的。
lines.en: Half the blood in the water is mine.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，很快正过来。
lines.en: I roll over and right myself fast.
My gills quicken for one beat.
The wound makes me meaner.
I dive down, away from the surface.
One pectoral fin isn't working right.
I rest a moment on the bottom.
I'll come back up.
Meat. Throw it in the water.
That fish is nearly dead. Perfect.
Throw it farther out.
I don't eat on land.
The blood in the water brought me.
Don't hold your hand that low.
This piece isn't big enough.
There's more meat smell on you.
I'll eat this first, then we'll talk.
Drop it and I'll leave.
You kicked my flank.
Your shove slides me a body length.
My hide is coarse and hard.
You stepped into my circle.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，水花乱溅。
lines.en: I hit your leg and water flies everywhere.

lines.zh: 水让我们的动作都变慢。
lines.en: The water slows us both down.

lines.zh: 你的脚落在我尾鳍旁边
lines.en: Your foot comes down beside my tail fin.
We've muddied the water between us.
I swerve around your feet.
That one pushed you back too.
There are other fins in this water.
It runs a head shorter than me.
We swam abreast for a stretch.
It nips my tail; I flick it off.
We shared one fish.
There's an old scar on its hide.
This water holds two sharks.

lines.zh: 我领着它绕那块礁石转
lines.en: I lead it around that reef rock.
It headed for deep water; I didn't follow.

lines.zh: 水混时，我们靠触感认路。
lines.en: In murky water we find each other by touch.
I clamp down and test the weight.

lines.zh: 这块肉从船上掉下来的。
lines.en: This meat fell from a boat.
I drag it to the bottom.
Fish scraps. I'll take them.
The bone's too hard; I spit it out.
I don't take metal.
I swallowed it in one go.
I can turn over what's on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我叼着它塞进石缝深处
lines.en: I carry it into a deep crack in the rocks.
Everything that falls in the water sinks to me.

lines.zh: 你身上破了口，我闻到了。
lines.en: You're bleeding. I can smell it.
I'm starting to circle.
The water's shallowing; you can't move fast.

lines.zh: 我把身体对准你的方向。
lines.en: I line my body up with you.
I'm coming from the deep side.

lines.zh: 你已经在我咬得到的距离里。
lines.en: You're already within biting range.

lines.zh: 我的鼻尖对上了你的腿。
lines.en: My snout has found your leg.
Once I bite, I won't let go.
I've been waiting a long time.
I split the water and charge straight at you.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下两层水深处。
lines.en: I'm two layers of water under your feet.
You retreat toward the bank; I follow.
I'm tightening my circles.
Every movement of your legs, I feel it.
I'm waiting for the water to get murkier.
The splash of your kicking is far too loud.
I swim past behind you.
My teeth are already showing.

lines.zh: 你要是往深水跑，就更糟。
lines.en: Running to deep water would only be worse.
I hold directly beneath you.

lines.zh: 我侧头一咬，牙齿进去了。
lines.en: I turn my head and the teeth sink in.
I clamp the flesh and whip my head side to side.

lines.zh: 血丝从我牙缝往四面飘
lines.en: Threads of blood drift out from between my teeth.
That bite found flesh.
I'm knocked aside and swim right back.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍扫过你的小腿
lines.en: My tail fin rakes across your calf.
You kicked me; it didn't help.
I bite and hold.
The taste in the water makes me hungrier.
I twist away to open distance.
I rise up from the deep.
A fin splits the river's surface.

lines.zh: 我先是影子，然后是牙齿。
lines.en: First a shadow, then teeth.
This water smells new to me.
I circle the river mouth once.
The warm current brought me here.
My stomach is empty.
I beat my tail to steady myself.
One more ripple appears on the water.

lines.zh: 我从河底的淤泥里拱出来
lines.en: I push up out of the riverbed silt.

lines.zh: 水面上有火，我沉了下去。
lines.en: There's fire on the surface; I sink away.

lines.zh: 水把我甩上岸，我拍进泥里
lines.en: The water flings me ashore and I slap into the mud.

lines.zh: 我在水里竟然也喘不上气。
lines.en: Even in water, I somehow can't breathe.

lines.zh: 水下炸开，冲击把我推开。
lines.en: An underwater blast shoves me away.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿了我的背鳍。
lines.en: An arrow punches through my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 光在水里炸开，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Light bursts underwater and blinds me.
Hunger makes my head swim and my swimming fail.

lines.zh: 电流过水，我连鳃都僵住
lines.en: Current runs through the water and locks my gills.
No water here; I cannot move.
